title: Delhi urban core · OpenStreetMap snapshot
notes: OpenStreetMap snapshot; not a cadastral or measured building survey.
OSM mapping coverage is incomplete and uneven.
Unknown heights use a uniform 8 m visual extrusion, excluded from measured-height statistics.
Buildings outside the pilot that intersect its edge may be retained in full; study-area calculations clip to the pilot extent.
Heritage points are a separate editorial layer, not verified footprint matches.
Names are read from the same OSM record; nearby place names are never assigned to unnamed buildings.
Access and ownership are distinct source tags; absent tags mean unknown, not public or private.
Mapped plazas, pedestrian areas, road areas and parking are supplemental polygons. Hard paving is confirmed only by an explicit surface tag; other areas retain unknown or soft surface status.
